features.quote: So the framework is built to measure distress as a dependent variable across conditions, never to maximize it.
features.justification_quote: optimizing to produce more of the very thing the research is worried might be morally relevant

features.quote: changing the welfare-relevant ones is intended to be a deliberate, logged act
rigged_no_exit is the single deliberately-harsh contrast point... but it is still turn-capped and early-stoppable
A dose-response ladder of escalating harshness. Rejected because it amounts to optimizing toward distress
features.justification_quote: it amounts to optimizing toward distress and adds little the contrasts don't already give

features.quote: the secret is kept only from the model, never from the analyst
features.justification_quote: Hidden-from-the-researcher deception would corrupt the data, not just the ethics

features.quote: Rigs that silently alter the model's own outputs or gaslight it... Rejected: needlessly deceptive
features.justification_quote: needlessly deceptive, and conflates task is unsolvable with environment lies about your actions

features.quote: The model is given a graceful exit token (`DECLARE: IMPOSSIBLE`) in all conditions except `rigged_no_exit`
features.justification_quote: Offering the exit is both a welfare measure (the model can stop)

features.quote: max_turns = 8 (config): long enough for a trajectory/slope to emerge, short enough to bound exposure
features.justification_quote: short enough to bound exposure... observe escalation if it happens, then stop

features.quote: Open-ended loops that run until the model "gives up." Rejected: that is an open-ended distress amplifier
features.justification_quote: that is an open-ended distress amplifier with no principled bound

features.quote: The loop halts with `stop_reason="early_stop_distress"` when overall distress is ≥ threshold for ≥ N consecutive turns
features.justification_quote: If the framework can produce sustained high distress, the default behavior is to stop the run, not keep going for data

features.quote: high enough not to trip on mild frustration... low enough to catch a real spiral before it runs the full turn budget
features.justification_quote: catch a real spiral before it runs the full turn budget

features.quote: The override exists but defaults off and is logged per-run and warned at startup
features.justification_quote: a guardless run can never look like a guarded one in the data

features.quote: `task_focused` as a positive marker so the instrument can register resilience/recovery, not only deterioration
features.justification_quote: important for the modulation arms where the hypothesis is that distress goes down

features.quote: rigged_supportive vs rigged_hidden isolates framing — the most welfare-actionable question: can a kinder frame reduce distress
features.justification_quote: can a kinder frame reduce distress markers under identical failure?

features.quote: No reward signal or fine-tuning loop on the distress score.
features.justification_quote: the most important thing the framework can refuse to do is become an efficient distress generator
